decisions.reason: Premium customer support directly supports the firm's 24/7 expert support and agency-focused service promise, so it remains central.
The version management tool builds on established tooling and supports developer customers, aligning with the firm's management tools offering.
The data processing contract tool is distant from core hosting and services and does not fit the strategic focus, so it is likely to be discontinued.
Scalable hosting for agencies is the flagship product directly aligned with the firm's agency-focused direction and should remain central.
